description: The selected second-season stories deepen Vulcan and Andorian tensions, revisit T'Pol's past and introduce the Borg before the Xindi attack sends Enterprise into the Delphic Expanse.

s02e01.description: Badly damaged Enterprise finds an automated repair station offering miraculous repairs, but the facility's real price is hidden from the crew.

s02e02.description: T'Pol is ordered to capture a fugitive Vulcan agent from her past, forcing her to confront a mission she never resolved emotionally.

s02e03.description: T'Pol's neurological illness exposes entrenched Vulcan prejudice while Phlox faces an unusually persistent romantic complication.

s02e04.description: Archer mediates a territorial standoff between Vulcans and Andorians, with both sides testing whether diplomacy can survive mutual distrust.

s02e05.description: Arctic researchers revive cybernetic survivors from a century-old wreck, unleashing a Borg threat that Enterprise barely understands.

s02e06.description: A devastating attack on Earth sends Enterprise toward the Delphic Expanse to find the Xindi before a larger weapon can be completed.
